thread:
incident-bot: PAGER: S2 - Elevated 5xx and queue saturation detected in Meridian dedicated pool (eu-west-1). Suspected tenant noisy neighbor impacting multi-tenant pool. Runbook: https://runbooks.redwood/meridian-dedicated-noise

on-call-jordan: Ack. Jumping in. Pulling current metrics and tenant map.

sre-lee: Seeing 5xx spike starting ~11:02 UTC, pod gp-m-07 showing 92% CPU and repeated OOM-kill logs for worker processes. KV-cache miss ratio spikes correlate with high request fanout.

on-call-jordan: Running tenant isolation flow. Targeting tenant 5821 as top offender per recent trace sampling.

eng-uma: Note: autoscale policy for meridian-eu has a deployed override set to min_replicas=2 from last week's emergency change. That reduces headroom for bursts.

on-call-jordan: Applying isolation:
```
isolator --pool meridian-eu --tenant 5821 --action isolate
kubectl apply -f tenant-5821-quota.yaml
redwoodctl pools update meridian-eu --burst-multiplier 1.8
```
Executing now.

ops-tim: Kicking routing fallback (policy: eu-dedicated-fallback) to move new sessions off the strained nodes.

incident-bot: deploy-bot: Routing change enacted by on-call-jordan at 11:12 UTC.

sre-lee: After isolation and routing switch 5xx dropped from 28% to 5% within 4 minutes. Latency normalized for other tenants.

on-call-jordan: Good. Isolated tenant 5821 and enforced quota. Collecting logs for root-cause.

cust-success-anya: Meridian ops contacted us — they reported failed inferences and timeouts affecting several of their end-users. They're asking: were any customer payloads exposed or lost? Also requesting an ETA and exec summary.

sre-lee: From traces: a subset of Meridian requests were retried to fallback pool and completed. No evidence of cross-tenant data access. Some in-flight requests timed out and returned errors while the pool was congested.

on-call-jordan: Drafting initial customer message: "We've isolated a noisy tenant in your dedicated pool and rerouted traffic to restore service. We're investigating root cause, preserving logs/traces, and will provide an RCA and proposed credit. Preliminary recovery for most endpoints: 11:16 UTC." Will post in 10.

acct-raj: Reminder: SLA credit calc uses aggregated endpoint availability. If total customer-impact window > 1 hour we trigger pro-rated credit. Keep exact error-window — I need timestamps.

eng-uma: Preliminary infra cause: a template bug in autoscale manifest caused integer truncation of CPU thresholds during last templated deploy (PR ref: infra#839). That left insufficient burst capacity under concurrent-heavy tenants.

devex-sam: Copy please drop the exact CLI and kubectl lines in this thread for the RCA. Also want the log grep commands.

on-call-jordan: CLI snippets: 
```
# tenant isolation
isolator --tenant 5821 --pool meridian-eu --apply
kubectl label ns tenant-5821 redwood/isolated=true
kubectl apply -f tenant-5821-quota.yaml
# bump burst
redwoodctl pools update meridian-eu --burst-multiplier 1.8
# enable fallback
redwoodctl routing set meridian-eu eu-dedicated-fallback
```

ops-tim: Confirmed retries to fallback preserved payloads; we forwarded retry headers and request ids. No lost messages recorded in request-store.

sre-lee: I'll own the RCA and timeline. Proposing: start 11:02 UTC (anomaly), isolation 11:12 UTC, service stable for majority 11:16 UTC, monitoring window till 13:30 UTC. RCA draft in PD ticket PD-4590.

cust-success-anya: Meridian asked for a 1:1 post-incident call and an executive note for their CTO. I'll prepare an exec summary and propose a 30min deep-dive next week. Also will offer a credit proposal: initial offer 4% pending final window calc.

acct-raj: 4% is an acceptable starting point. If final impacted time exceeds thresholds we may escalate to 6-8%. I'll compute exact figures once logs finalize.

on-call-jordan: Heads-up I'm stepping off in 30min. Handing to @sre-lee to continue postmortem. Please maintain isolation until autoscale fix deployed.

sre-lee: Taking over on-call. Locking isolation and starting full trace correlation and pod-level heap dumps. Filing RCA skeleton now.

eng-uma: I'll prepare the cherry-pick for the autoscale template fix and request a fast-track deploy to meridian-eu. Also adding a config-validation CI job to avoid integer truncation regressions.

devex-sam: I'll add a short KB for customers on how we handle retries and fallback routing for dedicated pools.

incident-bot: PD ticket created: PD-4590 assigned to sre-lee. Severity remains S2. Close after RCA and customer follow-up complete.

sre-lee: Update 12:45 UTC: Canary deploy of autoscale fix applied to a single node, behavior looks stable. No new 5xx spikes. Keeping quota and isolation until full confidence. RCA draft will include commands, timelines, and remediation plan.

cust-success-anya: Meridian expects the RCA within 48 hours and asked for the credit proposal in the same window. I'll coordinate review.

sre-lee: Roger. I'll attach logs, pod-level metrics, and the isolation command outputs to PD-4590 and ping for review.

acct-raj: Also flagging finance for potential credit exposure. CFO requested a short blurb by EOD: "Customer Meridian experienced transient errors affecting X endpoints between 11:02-11:16 UTC; estimated exposure under review."

on-call-jordan: Thanks everyone. Hand-off complete.

incident-bot: Reminder: keep thread updated with customer-facing drafts and attach RCA to PagerDuty ticket.

sre-lee: Final status 13:30 UTC: pool stable, isolation lifted at 13:30 after validation, follow-ups: backport autoscale template fix, add config-validator, schedule 1:1 with Meridian next week. RCA target: 48h.

cust-success-anya: I'll send the exec summary and credit proposal draft after review.
